description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: indicates the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: indicates regions outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-sls-log-store --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-zpr3d00000o --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-aek2wf3mn0000vq --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
